description: A photograph of an expansive agricultural field, likely depicting cropland or arable land, under active irrigation. The foreground shows freshly tilled or planted brown soil extending towards a horizon of gently rolling green hills under a partly cloudy sky. Several large, multi-wheeled centre-pivot irrigation systems are visible across the field, with water sprays clearly visible, indicating ongoing watering of the crops. This image illustrates irrigated cropland, consistent with "Arable Land" as defined in Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) documentation.
